sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Sector breadth is extremely narrow with only Technology maintaining an all-green profile, while defensive rotations lift Healthcare and Real Estate suffers the sharpest weekly decline.

Technology and Energy continue to command top-tier momentum, but broad market strength lacks confirmation across sectors as only 1 of 11 groups remains positive across all timeframes. Defensive positioning is showing signs of life, highlighted by Healthcare's recent climb into the top half of relative rankings. 

Concurrently, interest-rate-sensitive and cyclical segments are fading. Real Estate posted the steepest drop over the past five sessions, while Utilities and Consumer Cyclical sit anchored at the bottom of the momentum rankings. 

## Strength
- **Narrow leadership:** Technology is the sole sector (1 of 11) with an all-green profile across weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and YTD frames, leading all groups with a 0.900 momentum score (rank 2).
- **Sustained energy strength:** Energy holds the #1 YTD rank with the second-highest momentum score on the board at 0.817.
- **Upper-tier cohort:** Basic Materials retains solid relative positioning, holding the #3 rank with a 0.633 momentum score.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Healthcare surging:** Healthcare improved the most over the past 5 sessions, jumping +2 spots to rank 5 with a strong 0.733 momentum score.
- **Defensive inching up:** Consumer Defensive gained +1 spot to reach rank 7, though its momentum remains subdued at 0.400.
- **Severe momentum laggards:** Utilities registers as the weakest overall sector with a 0.067 momentum score (rank 10), joined at the bottom by Consumer Cyclical (0.200 momentum, rank 11).

## Divergences
- **Financial slipping:** Financial exhibits a fading divergence, shedding -1 spot over the last 5 sessions to rank 6 despite an otherwise solid 0.600 momentum score.
- **Real Estate rollover:** Real Estate led all decliners over the past 5 sessions, dropping -2 spots to rank 8 alongside a depressed 0.200 momentum score.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Narrow market breadth persists with just 9 of 144 groups all-green, led by sustained strength in Oil & Gas Refining and Marine Shipping, while healthcare niches surge and extractive resources sharply deteriorate.

Leadership remains anchored in high-momentum segments like Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (0.993 momentum) and Marine Shipping (0.960 momentum), both sustaining top-36 ranks across 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows. Rotation is strongly favoring healthcare services and pharmaceuticals, with Diagnostics & Research surging +26 spots and Health Information Services jumping +12 spots over the past 5 sessions. 

Conversely, mining and energy inputs are rapidly fading. Coking Coal plunged 39 spots, Aluminum dropped 23 spots, and Thermal Coal fell 13 spots over 5 sessions. High-momentum pockets like Gold (0.75 momentum) and Oil & Gas E&P (0.63 momentum) are flashing distribution warnings as their short-term ranks slip.

## Strength
- **All-Green Breadth:** Only 9 of 144 industry groups are positive across all timeframes (week, month, quarter, half, YTD), including Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (0.99 momentum), Marine Shipping (0.96 momentum), and Consumer Electronics (0.90 momentum).
- **Sustained Leadership:** Industries maintaining top-36 rank consistency across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons include Diagnostics & Research, Insurance - Reinsurance, Health Information Services, Software - Infrastructure, and Insurance - Life.
- **Top Momentum Anchors:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing ranks #2 YTD with a 0.993 momentum score, followed by Marine Shipping (#5 YTD, 0.960 momentum) and Copper (#12 YTD, 0.869 momentum).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Healthcare Accelerating:** Diagnostics & Research gained +26 spots (rank 45, momentum 0.89), Drug Manufacturers - Specialty & Generic advanced +16 spots (rank 81, momentum 0.61), and Health Information Services rose +12 spots (rank 39, momentum 0.83).
- **Resource & Industrial De-rating:** Coking Coal dropped -39 spots (rank 107, momentum 0.26), Business Equipment & Supplies fell -27 spots (rank 69, momentum 0.47), and Aluminum shed -23 spots (rank 96, momentum 0.24).
- **Persistent Momentum Laggards:** Mortgage Finance (0.037 momentum, rank 142 YTD), Gambling (0.091 momentum, rank 143 YTD), and Footwear & Accessories (0.094 momentum, rank 141 YTD) remain anchored at the bottom.

## Divergences
- **Fading Leaders:** High-momentum groups showing 5-day rank declines include Gold (momentum 0.75, rank -2), Banks - Diversified (momentum 0.70, rank -3), Agricultural Inputs (momentum 0.65, rank -2), and Oil & Gas E&P (momentum 0.63, rank -4).
- **Emerging Bottom Turnarounds:** Early short-term rank jumps with sub-0.50 momentum include Conglomerates (rank +10, momentum 0.49), Education & Training Services (rank +9, momentum 0.48), Real Estate - Development (rank +9, momentum 0.37), and Aerospace & Defense (rank +8, momentum 0.43).
